title: CrowdStrike to shell out nearly $500M for 2 AI security startups as the market for securing agents takes off
summary: CrowdStrike于11月3日宣布分别签署收购Fiddler AI和Dreadnode的协议，前者侧重Agent可观测性，后者做上线前自动安全测试。TechCrunch报道两笔交易合计接近5亿美元，金额来自媒体援引而非公司公告。
investorNote: 安全厂商正在把Agent的上线前测试和运行时行为监控并入现有平台，整合落地比交易金额更值得跟踪。

evidence.quote: CrowdStrike is buying two AI security companies

it will buy
Fiddler AI
, which makes observability software for monitoring AI agents inside enterprises, and
Dreadnode
, which helps companies automate security testing specifically aimed at detecting flaws in AI models, apps, and agents before they are set live.

The company is paying around $400 million for Fiddler AI, and about $95 million for Dreadnode,
according to The Wall Street Journal

displayTitle: CrowdStrike拟收购Fiddler与Dreadnode，补齐Agent观测和攻防测试
narrative: 这两笔尚待交割的收购对应Agent安全链条的两端：Dreadnode测试模型与应用弱点，Fiddler记录并解释运行行为。CrowdStrike试图把结果接入Falcon平台；产品何时普遍可用以及客户是否统一采购，仍要看后续交付。
